text_block_list.name: A Certain Team Trainer
text_block_list.text: 3, 2, 1—start.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Yes...!

text_block_list.name: A Certain Team Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Be mindful of your pacing—
Bouquet, your shoulders are rising again.

...And the one currently guiding her
is a deeply experienced chief trainer
who took care of me back in my sub-trainer days.

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text: How about asking the chief trainer who used to look after you to come watch your training?

"The advice I received from a fellow Trainer that day.
At first, I was bewildered, but—"

Back at the dorm, once I reconsidered it,
it didn't seem like such a bad idea after all.
Maybe a veteran Trainer with tons of experience could spot something I'm missing.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I see—
To the Chief Trainer, then?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Anything you feel is necessary is necessary for me as well.
Please, let's do it.

And so—upon contacting the Head Trainer,
it was decided that they would participate in training on a regular basis.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Haaah, haaah...

text_block_list.name: A Certain Team Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Good work.
How did the training load feel?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
It felt... just right.
Like taking small steps where each goal was within reach with just a bit of effort.

text_block_list.name: A Certain Team Trainer
text_block_list.text:
I see, it seems suited for you.
It's a training method I used to do often with a girl
whose running style was very similar to yours.

text_block_list.name: A Certain Team Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Trainer <username>.
I'll hand over the materials from back then later.
The training sessions proposed by the Chief Trainer were precise and efficient, rooted in profound knowledge and experience.

text_block_list.name: A Certain Team Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Mind your posture. 288, 289, 290...
Just a little more, hold that form, hold it!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa... gh!

text_block_list.name: A Certain Team Trainer
text_block_list.text:
—Yeah.
Final 3 furlongs, that's a personal best!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
R-Really...!?
Oh, my... hehe!
—And then.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: “We hear that you have currently welcomed that famous trainer as a training advisor for Curren Bouquetd'or.”

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"If you wouldn't mind,
would you please allow me to interview you?"
She was chosen for a dedicated feature in the widely known racing magazine, Monthly Twinkle.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: And lastly, please pose for a few photos.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Umm—like this, maybe?
choice_data_list: (Before I knew it, interview requests came pouring in)

text_block_list.text: With the Chief Trainer's name acting as the catalyst, the talented girl was finally stepping into the spotlight she deserved.

Her opportunities to shine will expand even further.
This might end up having an impact on
race results going forward as well.

There's nothing more I could ask for.
It's something I could never have done for her myself.
I'm grateful from the bottom of my heart, and yet—

With his power, in the blink of an eye,
she stepped out beneath the light—and how she looked then was...
It was dazzling enough to freeze me right in my tracks.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ...Oh? Where... am I—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: The trainer's office...?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Trainer?
...? With all that luggage, are you heading out somewhere?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...G-Ghh, Trainer...?
Where are you going? Where to—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ...? Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
………………! Wait!
—Wait, no! Don't go...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Don't go anywhere—!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Ah!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Was I... dreaming...?
A warm afternoon. When I gently woke Curren Bouquetd'or, who had fallen asleep before I knew it, she jumped up with a start.
choice_data_list: Are you okay? You seemed to be having a nightmare...
Are you okay? You were tossing and groaning in your sleep...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Y—Yes...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
It seems I was just a little tired.
But I'm fine now, so—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: I'll go to sleep a little early today.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(What a strange dream...
Am I tired, I wonder?)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: (…Still…)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: (...I knew it, I just can't help but care.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(It's just a dream—
Still, just in case...)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: (Being ignored... is terrifying――)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(I have to do something.
But――what should I do?)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Mmm……

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...—"Consistent race record"—
"Showcasing remarkable grit in tough developments"...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...Are you looking into
information about yourself?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I-I'm sorry.
It's just, you've been so dedicated lately...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Um... I have plenty of reference materials, so please feel free to ask whenever you need them.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Ah—
Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Um, Chrono-san.
About that—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"A special glory that only my legs can seize—
what do you think that might be?"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"Bouquet-san's legs—
Is that... why?"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I desperately want to know right now.
However, I just can't seem to figure it out on my own.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Chrono-san has such a broad perspective.
I was hoping I might borrow some of her wisdom—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: "Wouldn't making the most of stamina be the way to go after all?"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: The reason she shifted course from the Oka Sho to the Sweetpea Stakes is probably because it's closer to her optimal distance, right?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"Even in the races we've run together before,
I always felt your incredible late-stage burst
as I ran alongside you, andâ"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"Yes.
Um, Miss Bouquet is... remarkably tough, isn't she—"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...During our summer hike as well,
I could truly sense your extraordinary stamina.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Stamina—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
A special victory that you can aim for, Bouquet-san...
If that's what you mean, there is definitely one.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
An ultra-challenging crown where not a single Tiara Umamusume
has even placed in the top five in over 50 years—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"Even that great heroine of Australia
failed to finish in the top five—"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: "Even she, who achieved great results in the Hanshin Daishoten, was defeated—"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: The phantom... spring crown.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: —I see, you mean that race... However, that is—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: That is a very high wall to overcome.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: (If I can give them to Trainer, they'll surely become truly special flowers.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: (Still... can I really do it?)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(How can I achieve it?
What must I do to steel my resolve?
I want to know—how to seize that special glory.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ...That's true.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—Hello? Mom?
Um... there's something I'd like to talk to you about.

text_block_list.name: Bouquet's Mother
text_block_list.text: "I see. So, that's how you seize a special glory, huh..."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
Mom, what were you feeling when you ran in the past...
and won all those crowns...?

text_block_list.name: Bouquet's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"'...—
What you need is confidence, and the firm conviction to back it up.'"

text_block_list.name: Bouquet's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"‘That's why—hey, Bouquet-chan.
Could you take a slightly longer vacation?’"

text_block_list.name: Bouquet's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"So, would you like to come with me to the country
where I used to spend my days racing?"
